==================
import with alias, backend None, include in acl and backend
==================

import debug as dbg;
import std from "/x.so";
backend b None;
backend c {
	include "props.vcl";
	.host = "x";
}
acl block {
	include "${tmpdir}/_acl.vcl";
	"10.0.0.0"/8;
}

==================
blob literal, modulus, call of vmod sub, member expression, new return actions
==================

sub vcl_backend_refresh {
	set resp.body = :aGVsbG93b3JsZA==:;
	set resp.http.residual = resp.status % 10000;
	set resp.http.l-mod = (req.url + "bar").lower();
	call c.xsub();
	call strip;
	return (merge);
	return (beresp);
	return (obj_stale);
	return (connect);
}
